name: Caesar Chicken Bake

fit.note: 581 cal is inside 400-650; 9g carb is well under the 35g ceiling; oven-bake casserole, weigh-and-divide scalable to 14; no seafood as a dish.

dupe_check.catalog: No Caesar dish exists in the 544-recipe digest. Nearest chicken bakes are chicken-cordon-bleu-casserole (ham+swiss), chicken-divan-broccoli-bake (broccoli+cream-of), hunters-chicken-bbq-bacon-bake (BBQ+bacon), and loaded-chicken-and-potato-casserole (potato base) - all a different sauce/flavor family, so not a duplicate.
dupe_check.accepted_slugs: Read fresh: closest live entry is chicken-bacon-ranch-cauliflower-bake, but that is a ranch-and-bacon cauliflower bake, a different sauce family and different base from a Caesar-dressing-bound chicken bake - not a dupe.

evidence: Distinguishing element is the Caesar dressing binding (garlic/parmesan/lemon profile); no catalog or accepted recipe uses it, so no near-duplicate.
flags: Caesar dressing traditionally contains anchovy; treated as a trace seasoning, not a seafood dish - decider may want to confirm against the 'no seafood' condition.
unmapped ingredient: croutons (topping) - wanted for the pricer lane, not a reason to drop.
cross_protein_collision: Structure is protein baked under a creamy dressing + shredded cheese + crumb topping. Could collide with a turkey version (e.g. 'Caesar turkey bake' or a creamy/ranch turkey bake) or a pork-chop creamy-cheese bake in another selector's pool. Decider should watch for a same-structure Caesar/creamy-dressing bake under turkey or pork.
